description: TopBar fixed header collided directly with MobileHomeScreen clock, live time digits, and reachability status header.
reproduction: Open OmniverseOS on mobile viewport (412x915) with no active windows. Observe the top 60px.
expected: TopBar should sit cleanly above MobileHomeScreen with proper vertical offset; no element should be covered.
actual: TopBar (height 60px, zIndex 50) rendered over MobileHomeScreen (paddingTop 12px), slicing the clock digits in half and covering the status row.
root_cause: MobileHomeScreen container had fixed inset 0 and only 12px paddingTop, ignoring TopBar's 60px height. In addition, MobileHomeScreen rendered a duplicate fake status row in the same coordinate space.
fix: Set paddingTop to 'calc(68px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px))' and styled One UI Cortex Core telemetry as an embedded sub-badge below TopBar.
risk: Low. TopBar remains unchanged on desktop; mobile layout gains 68px breathing room.

description: Double dock rendering: Desktop.js MobileDock and MobileHomeScreen SmartDock rendered simultaneously, with CortexPill floating directly over MobileDock icons.
reproduction: Navigate to mobile homescreen. Inspect bottom 120px. Note two distinct dock containers rendered on top of each other.
expected: Single cohesive One UI bottom dock interaction surface with Cortex Assistant trigger cleanly positioned above it.
actual: Desktop.js rendered MobileDock (Y=809..915); CortexPill floated at Y=847..897 directly covering MobileDock icons; MobileHomeScreen also rendered SmartDock in feed.
root_cause: Dock.js rendered an independent MobileDock on touch devices while MobileHomeScreen also rendered its own One UI SmartDock and floating CortexPill.
fix: Suppressed redundant MobileDock in Dock.js on touch devices (where MobileHomeScreen provides the dock); embedded CortexPill directly above MobileSmartDock in a unified One UI fixed bottom container with 170px scroll clearance.
risk: Low. Desktop dock is untouched (DesktopDock isTablet=false renders unchanged).

description: Hardcoded 224px desktop sidebar consumed 62% of mobile screen width, crushing file table into 136px and causing 5-line text wrapping on dates and sizes.
reproduction: Open Files app on viewport 360x800. Observe workspace locations sidebar taking over half the screen.
expected: Full-width file list on mobile with clean 2-column layout and horizontal location selector chips.
actual: Sidebar forced w-56 flex-shrink-0; Date Modified wrapped into 5 lines ('Date' / 'vModifi' / 'ed'); footer status bar overflowed.
root_cause: FileManager.js had non-responsive sidebar (w-56) and hardcoded 4-column desktop grid for all screen widths.
fix: Made sidebar 'hidden md:flex w-56'; added horizontal category pills on mobile; made file list 2-column on mobile (File Name with metadata subtitle, Size) and 4-column on desktop (md:grid-cols-12).
risk: None. Desktop retains full 224px sidebar and 4-column table.

description: 4-column grid forced on narrow viewports (<350px) caused icon squishing and label clipping on Samsung Galaxy Fold cover screens.
reproduction: Set viewport to 280x653. Open App Drawer. Observe 4 columns crammed into 248px net width.
expected: Responsive 3-column layout below 350px with centered labels and smooth breathing room.
actual: AppDrawerIcon had hardcoded minWidth: 64px inside repeat(4, 1fr) (62px column width), overflowing grid columns.
root_cause: MobileAppDrawer.js line 653 hardcoded repeat(4, 1fr) without breakpoint checking, and AppDrawerIcon had minWidth: 64.
fix: Implemented dynamic 3-column grid for viewports <350px (repeat(3, 1fr)) and 4-column for >=350px; removed minWidth: 64 to allow flexible fluid scaling; mounted drawer via createPortal to document.body.
risk: None. Drawer layout on standard phones (390px+) retains 4 columns.

description: Composer input lacked safe-area bottom inset; modal was trapped inside MobileHomeScreen zIndex 10 stacking context causing TopBar to intercept Back/Close clicks.
reproduction: Open Mobile AI Chat on iPhone viewport (390x844). Tap Back button at top-left. TopBar intercepts touch.
expected: Full-screen modal covers TopBar; Back/Close buttons receive touch input immediately; input form sits above home indicator bar.
actual: TopBar (zIndex 50 in parent Desktop.js) intercepted pointer events intended for MobileAIChat (zIndex 250 in child MobileHomeScreen with parent zIndex 10); composer padding had hardcoded 18px bottom.
root_cause: CSS Stacking context trapping in Desktop.js / MobileHomeScreen.js; missing env(safe-area-inset-bottom) in form padding.
fix: Mounted MobileAIChat via createPortal directly into document.body at zIndex 9999; added env(safe-area-inset-top) to header and env(safe-area-inset-bottom) to input form.
risk: None. Standard React Portal pattern ensures isolation.

description: Hardcoded 224px sidebar crushed photo grid into 151px width on mobile, causing 50px squished thumbnail cards, wrapped headers, and truncated search input.
reproduction: Open Photos app on 375x812 viewport. Observe sidebar consuming 60% of width.
expected: Full-width 2-column high-resolution gallery grid on mobile with horizontal category pill selector.
actual: Sidebar w-56 crushed right content pane; search bar overflowed header; thumbnails squeezed into tiny boxes.
root_cause: PhotosApp.js line 200 hardcoded desktop sidebar (w-56 flex-shrink-0) on all viewport sizes.
fix: Made sidebar 'hidden md:flex w-56'; added horizontal category selector pills for mobile; gave photo gallery full width with 2 responsive columns (aspect 4/3); responsive search bar.
risk: None. Desktop retains full sidebar and 4-column gallery.
